answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming like cedar shading out weeds: every agent gets five auditors, who check each other's work before payment. Auditors stake twice their 30-day expected reward, so a fake passes only if all five collude; N fakes cost five times N deposits. At the nadir, audits double; verdicts come out crystal-clear. Honest agents pay one deposit and keep full rewards; a ring loses all N deposits when one auditor defects.
